instructions.name: claim_lost_spend
docs: Burns what the loss of the branch that lost the contested output proves.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: the claim pays nobody, so nobody needs standing to file it.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable because the burn lowers its supply.

accounts.name: device
docs: The device that owns the liable lock, read only when the culprit's spend named no lock: its
current wallet is the one a loss paid to itself cannot burn the bond of.

accounts.name: claim
docs: which creates it.

instructions.name: claim_unbacked
docs: Burns what the loss of a chain the issuer's backing can no longer pay proves.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone: the claim pays nobody, so nobody needs standing to file it.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable because the burn lowers its supply.

accounts.name: claim
docs: which creates it.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: account, which anyone may have sent lamports to.

instructions.name: close_proof_buffer
docs: Closes a buffer nobody settled within `STALE_BUFFER_SECS` and returns its rent.

instructions.name: close_records
docs: Closes claims whose retention has passed.

instructions.name: close_spent
docs: Closes the records whose retention has passed and returns their rent to whoever paid it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the lock's three accounts and gets it back at release and close.

instructions.name: migrate_device
docs: Grows a `Device` that predates the counters to the current layout. Devnet builds only.

instructions.name: open_proof_buffer
docs: Opens a buffer for the messages of a chain too long for one transaction.

instructions.name: reclaim_output
docs: Takes back an output nobody settled in time, for the wallet its owner's key is bound to.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Owned by the wallet the owner's key is bound to: a reclaim cannot send funds anywhere the
wallet did not already control.

instructions.name: record_prefix
docs: Records the consumed outputs of a chain without paying, so a later settlement of the chain
needs the signature of its last message only.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the records.

instructions.name: register_attester
docs: Registers an attester with its stake. The authority signs and may be a multisig.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the attester's three accounts and gets the ledger's and the escrow's back
when the stake is withdrawn.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The wallet the key is bound to: its signature is the consent, checked against the binding.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the device account's rent: the wallet itself, or a sponsor.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Owned by the lock's wallet: a release cannot send funds anywhere the wallet did not already
control.

instructions.name: report_false_ticket
docs: Destroys the whole stake of the attester that signed a ticket the chain contradicts.

accounts.name: reporter
docs: Anyone: the report pays nobody, so nobody needs standing to file it.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable because the burn lowers its supply.

accounts.name: device
docs: handler.

accounts.name: lock
docs: handler.

instructions.name: revoke_previous_vk
docs: Ends the acceptance of the previous verifying key; the pauser or the admin may call it.

instructions.name: rotate_attester_key
docs: Replaces the key that signs tickets; the old one stays accountable for `EXIT_DELAY`.

instructions.name: set_zk_paused
docs: The pauser may only pause; the admin may do either.

instructions.name: settle_chain_proof
docs: Settles a chain by one batch of proofs: pays the account the last message names and
records every consumed output, with no key or signature of the chain on chain.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the records and of the draws account; the fee payer in the usual case.

accounts.name: zk_mint
docs: reported as `MintNotEnabled`.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of the mint; the handler requires its owner to be the account the note
pays, which the proofs bind.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: The messages, when they did not fit the transaction; closed to its payer, who is the signer.

instructions.name: settle_note
docs: Settles the chain `issue` plus `spends` in clear: pays the account its last spend names.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the records; the fee payer in the usual case.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of the mint; the handler requires its owner to be the account the note
pays. The escrow is refused by the runtime's duplicate-account check as well.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of the mint but the escrow itself: the authority's signature names it.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of the mint but the escrow itself: the wallet's signature names it.

types.name: Attester
docs: A registered attester: who answers for it, which mint its stake and tickets are in, and the key
that signs its tickets. Its stake is in the `Ledger` and escrow at `["ledger", attester]` and
`["escrow", attester]`. The record is never closed, so an id is never reused.

fields.name: authority
docs: Signs every instruction that changes the attester, and its revocations.

fields.name: key
docs: Signs new tickets.

fields.name: prev_key
docs: The key before the last rotation; all zeros if none. Accountable until `prev_until`.

fields.name: prev_trusted_until
docs: Receivers believe the previous key before this time; zero after a compromise.

fields.name: exit_at
docs: When the attester asked to leave or was slashed.

fields.name: sponsor_fee
docs: Paid by the wallet to `sponsor_token` on top of `bond + backing`; see `process`.

types.name: Device
docs: A device key bound to a wallet, with the counters of its locks and wallet rotations. The key is
in the account's seeds, so it is not stored. `wallet` and `bump` keep the offsets they have always
had; the counters come after them.

fields.name: next_lock_seq
docs: The sequence number the next lock must use: strictly increasing across mints, never reaches
`NO_LOCK` as a lock's number.

fields.name: rotations
docs: Replay counter of wallet rotations.

types.name: KeyHashes
docs: The hashes of the key files the app trusts: verifying key, proving key (binary and dump) and
constraint system.

types.name: Ledger
docs: The mutable accounting of a lock and the authority of its escrow token account. The three
buckets only move forward; see `accounting`.

fields.name: backing_left
docs: Backing not yet paid out.

fields.name: bond_free
docs: Bond not committed to a slash.

fields.name: bond_slashed
docs: The pool: bond committed to claims, burn and reporter.

fields.name: payer
docs: Gets every rent back.

fields.name: key
docs: The device key, so the locks of one key can be listed with an account filter.

types.name: Link
docs: One spend of the chain: which output of the previous message it consumes (0 is the payment,
1 the change) and its body. Its signature and slot travel in the precompile instruction.

types.name: Lock
docs: The immutable record of a bond lock. It is written once by `create_lock` and read by everything
else; it states exactly the fields of a bond ticket.

fields.name: escrow_bump
docs: The canonical bump of the lock's escrow, so settlements derive it without searching: the
issuer's key chooses the lock's address and with it the cost of that search.

types.name: LostSpend
docs: The chain of a branch that lost: the issue and the spends up to and including the culprit's, the
last spend. The loss claimed is the culprit's payment, output 0 of that spend. `lock_key` and
`lock_seq` name the lock that backed it.

types.name: ProofBuffer
docs: Messages written by a settler ahead of the settlement transaction that reads them. The
messages follow this header in the account, `len` bytes of them.

fields.name: written
docs: The bytes written so far; writes may not leave a gap.

types.name: Rotation
docs: A pending change of a device's wallet.

fields.name: rotated_at
docs: When the key before `current` was replaced; zero when no previous key is accepted.
